title.narrative: Les mandants burundais mettent en œuvre des politiques et mesures intégrées et cohérentes pour des transitions justes

description.narrative: This Country Programme Outcome addresses the urgent need for sustainable employment and economic resilience in Burundi following the devastating impacts of the El Niño floods. By focusing on creating decent and sustainable jobs, the programme supports vulnerable groups such as women, youth, and displaced populations, fostering peace and stability in a fragile context. Through targeted initiatives in agriculture, infrastructure, and green jobs, the programme links disaster recovery with economic transformation. It leverages the ILO’s expertise to strengthen labour market systems, align skills development with sectoral needs, and promote gender equality and social inclusion. Beneficiaries include affected communities, government institutions, and private sector actors. Key implementing partners include national ministries, UN agencies, and international development organizations. This initiative represents a comprehensive response to the socio-economic challenges facing Burundi, promoting inclusive growth and resilience while addressing the root causes of unemployment and vulnerability.
